assets.initial: Two packaged font URLs returned 404 after bundling
assets.cause: Published JavaScript asset modules use new URL(relativePath, import.meta.url); the probe bundle moved the referencing module without relocating font assets.
assets.probeFix: A scoped Bun onLoad hook turns those two font modules into file imports; Bun emits fonts under publicPath /dev/.
assets.after: Both font requests returned 200; no error-level console messages on corrected Lit reload.

limits: Synthetic panels only, not the design-system inspector
One browser, no Firefox or WebKit run
No network event bus or editor source bridge tested
Solid is a dependency of the development shell
The published core package also declares an intent executable; avoid ambiguous bare CLI names when integrating with @tanstack/intent
Initial Lit fixture used shadowing class fields; corrected to constructor assignments before successful tests

fixtureSources.index.html: Devtools integration probe

build.assetAdapter: For the two devtools-ui/dist/esm/assets/fonts/*.js modules, resolve the static new URL path against the original module and export a Bun file import instead. This is a scoped probe, not a general asset transformer.
